nodes.label: Nomisma Windows 11 Pro x64 desktop
nodes.rationale: Per-user installer and portable ZIP bundle Python/.NET for Intel/AMD Windows 11; shared WebView2 Runtime remains required. Builds are unsigned, and checksums do not provide publisher signing. Portable packaging still stores research in the user profile.

nodes.label: Clean source export and GitHub release workflow
nodes.rationale: Exported source excludes Git history, credentials, databases, backups, binaries and caches because old history contains a database. A new extracted repository activates Windows CI; tagged releases publish only verified packages. Cross-compilation on Mac cannot replace native Windows verification.

nodes.label: Windows service ownership and persistent user data
nodes.rationale: App code is separate from profile data/credentials. Closing Windows stops only a service the app started; independently running services survive. Owned-service restart reloads credentials and requires a new monitor Start. Updates/uninstall preserve profile research and preferences.

nodes.label: Windows startup timing and bounded logs
nodes.rationale: Avoid sequential refused-connection timeouts by binding free ports locally, probing occupied ports concurrently and bypassing proxy discovery. startup.log records version, success and backend/WebView/page milestones, with 256 KiB rotation and no credentials or market data.

nodes.label: Pinned Windows packaging toolchain
nodes.rationale: Cross-platform builder requires Python 3.9+, .NET 10 SDK and NSIS 3. Windows Python/timezone downloads are pinned and checksum-verified; WebView2 package is pinned. Outputs include installer, portable ZIP and SHA256SUMS.
